data.arguments: {"summary": "Fixed Cache.__setitem__ capacity accounting: compute diffsize (replacement delta) before eviction and evict while currsize + diffsize exceeds maxsize, so growing replacements that fit no longer evict unrelated entries. If eviction removes the key being replaced, diffsize is reset to the full size so currsize stays accurate. Equal-size replacements, shrinking values, new insertions, and oversized-value errors keep their behavior."}
